intervention.definition: Keep per-candidate channel centering and learned gamma/beta; replace candidate-specific LN2 denominator by sqrt(mean_over_valid_candidates(channel_variance(x_i)) + eps), computed once from the original path for this state and held fixed for local derivatives and all checks.
intervention.interpretation: operator sensitivity probe at frozen weights, not a trained or deployment-ready policy

anchor_selection: first observation in the existing frozen manifest per instance; 17 anchors

layerwise_all_states: candidate RMS around the candidate mean
measurement.contrast_perturbation: x_new = x + 0.001 * (x - mean_candidates(x)); tree state unchanged
measurement.score_target: negative log probability of the saved action; not PPO loss
measurement.effective_rank: trace(C^T C)^2 / trace((C^T C)^2), C candidate-centered; zero if C is exactly zero

predeclared_screens.strong_contraction: ratio of output/input relative-centered-RMS <= 0.1; >=80% of instance medians must meet it for each checkpoint to call it cross-checkpoint consistent

stops: 600 second cumulative single-CPU ceiling, including reserve; partial results must be reported if hit
nonfinite tensors, input/checkpoint/source hash drift, parameter changes, wrong mask or failed invariance check
do not adjust the intervention after observing its scores
if scale preservation fails, mark the intervention inconclusive without searching another variant
after this single predefined comparison, submit evidence and continue/stop recommendation; no training or solver follow-on
evidence_limits: frozen-weight failure does not rule out retraining
